The '''coral scepter''' was a personal defense weapon favored by the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] and manufactured by [[Tibrin Exotic Armaments]]. It was a staff-like weapon that fired razor sharp [[Coral/Legends|coral]] pellets.
